reviews.shade: WELLAGE Real Hyaluronic One Day Kit 7ea (Capsule 15ml*7, Solution 1ml*7)
reviews.text: I love these! You get 7 serums and 7 hydration capsules and it is super easy to mix a serum with a capsule. Each one is sealed so you know all the beneficial ingredients are as fresh as it gets when you pop open the little ampoules. The texture of the mixed serum with the hydration capsule remains quite liquid so it is more on the side of a watery serum but that means it absorbs very quickly. As a person with sensitive skin this is perfect for me as it does not irritate my face at all. I apply it right after I have cleansed my face and before I apply my normal moisturizer. Would highly recommend.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢啲！有 7 支精華同 7 粒補水膠囊，而且好容易將精華同膠囊混合。每一支都有密封，所以打開個細安瓶嗰陣，你會知道有益成分係最新鮮嘅。混合咗補水膠囊嘅精華質地仍然幾液態，所以比較似水狀精華，但係咁就即係吸收得好快。作為敏感肌膚嘅人，呢款對我嚟講好啱，因為完全唔會刺激我個面。我喺潔面之後、搽返我平時用嘅保濕霜之前搽。非常推薦。

reviews.shade: WELLAGE Real Hyaluronic One Day Kit 7ea (Capsule 15ml*7, Solution 1ml*7)
reviews.text: My absolute holy grail for traveling! Whenever my skin feels dehydrated or irritated after a flight, this single-use kit instantly rescues it. It plumps up the skin and leaves a gorgeous, glassy glow by the next morning.
reviews.zh: 旅行必備，絕對係我嘅 holy grail！每次坐完飛機皮膚缺水或者覺得不適，呢個一次性套裝即刻就可以救返我嘅皮膚。佢令皮膚飽滿，翌朝都會留低一層漂亮嘅晶瑩光澤。

reviews.shade: WELLAGE Real Hyaluronic One Day Kit 7ea (Capsule 15ml*7, Solution 1ml*7)
reviews.text: A bit pricy for a single-use treatment. I love packing these whenever I travel because dry hotel rooms usually wreck my face, but with this, I wake up with plump, glassy, deeply hydrated skin every single time.
reviews.zh: 一次性護理有少少貴。我每次旅行都好鍾意帶住，因為酒店房通常好乾，會搞到我個面好差，不過用咗呢款，每一次醒返嚟，皮膚都係飽滿、晶瑩、深層補水嘅狀態。

reviews.shade: WELLAGE Real Hyaluronic One Day Kit 7ea (Capsule 15ml*7, Solution 1ml*7)
reviews.text: I really enjoyed using this kit. My skin feels noticeably more hydrated, plump and smooth after using it. It’s especially nice when my skin feels dry or needs an extra boost. The individual packs are also very convenient and hygienic.
reviews.zh: 我好享受用呢套產品。用咗之後，皮膚感覺明顯更加補足水分、飽滿同順滑。當皮膚覺得乾燥或者需要多啲補充嗰陣，尤其好用。獨立包裝都好方便同衛生。

reviews.shade: WELLAGE Real Hyaluronic One Day Kit 1ea (Capsule 15mg+Solution 1ml)
reviews.text: I really like this brand and have enjoyed several of their products. This one does exactly what I wanted: it gives my skin plenty of hydration. It felt a little heavy at first, but it absorbed nicely after a while and left my skin looking glowy, smooth, and plump.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個品牌，之前試過佢哋好幾款產品，都好滿意。呢款完全符合我想要嘅效果：畀我皮膚好多水分。起初感覺有少少厚重，但係過咗一陣就吸收得好好，令皮膚睇落有光澤、順滑又飽滿。

reviews.shade: WELLAGE Real Hyaluronic One Day Kit 7ea (Capsule 15ml*7, Solution 1ml*7)
reviews.text: The WELLAGE Real Hyaluronic One Day Kit is a skincare essential that delivers a daily burst of deep hydration and a radiant glow in convenient single-use vials. Its lightweight, non-sticky formula absorbs quickly, making it perfect for travel and everyday use.
reviews.zh: WELLAGE Real Hyaluronic One Day Kit 係一款護膚必備品，以方便嘅單次用量小瓶裝，每日提供深層補水同光采。佢嘅質地輕盈、唔黏，吸收好快，好適合旅行同日常使用。

reviews.shade: WELLAGE Real Hyaluronic One Day Kit 7ea (Capsule 15ml*7, Solution 1ml*7)
reviews.text:
Hey skincare enthusiasts! 🌟 If you're searching for a game-changing boost for your skin, let me introduce you to the WELLAGE Real Hyaluronic One Day Kit 7 Count. This kit is the ultimate pick-me-up for anyone needing a hydration and glow revival!

Each kit contains seven single-use vials of pure hyaluronic acid magic. Hyaluronic acid is known for its incredible ability to retain moisture and plump up your skin, making it look youthful and radiant. With this kit, you get a fresh dose of hydration every day, giving your skin that coveted dewy glow.

What I absolutely adore about this kit is its convenience. The vials are perfect for travel or on-the-go use. Just twist open a vial, apply the serum to your face, and let it work its magic. The lightweight, non-sticky formula absorbs quickly, leaving your skin feeling instantly refreshed and hydrated.

The WELLAGE Real Hyaluronic One Day Kit is a true skincare gem for anyone struggling with dryness or dullness.
reviews.zh:
護膚愛好者大家好！🌟 如果你想搵一款可以令皮膚即刻有提升嘅產品，就讓我向你介紹 WELLAGE Real Hyaluronic One Day Kit 7 Count。呢套產品係任何需要補水同重拾光采嘅人嘅終極救星！

每套有七支單次用量嘅小瓶，裝住純粹嘅透明質酸魔法精華。透明質酸以其鎖住水分同令肌膚飽滿嘅驚人能力見稱，令肌膚睇落更年輕、有光澤。用呢套產品，你每日都可以獲得新鮮嘅水分補充，令皮膚有渴求已久嘅水潤光澤。

我最鍾意呢套產品嘅方便性。小瓶好適合旅行或者外出時用。只需要擰開一支小瓶，將精華搽喺面上，就可以讓佢發揮魔力。質地輕盈、唔黏，吸收好快，令皮膚即時感到清爽同補足水分。

WELLAGE Real Hyaluronic One Day Kit 係一件真正嘅護膚寶物，適合所有為乾燥或者暗啞而煩惱嘅人。

reviews.shade: WELLAGE Real Hyaluronic One Day Kit 10ea Special Offer
reviews.text: I have a bit mixed feelings about this product. At the first I used it, it was so moisturising! It was amazing, so I used it 3 days in a row, and then my face is starting to breakout. I stopped to use it. Maybe you are not suppose to use it days in a row, but only 2 or 3 times a week.
reviews.zh: 我對呢款產品有啲矛盾嘅感受。第一次用嗰陣，佢好滋潤！好好用，所以我連續用咗三日，之後我面開始爆痘。我就停咗唔用。可能唔係要連續日日用，而係每星期只用兩至三次就得。
